title: Floating music-player editorial
reference_style: Minimal grey studio portrait surrounded by floating music interfaces and subtle light trails.

reverse_engineered_prompt.concept: Minimal futuristic music campaign portrait with floating playback cards arranged in spatial depth.

subject.pose: Standing centered, torso angled subtly, chin lifted, looking directly at camera
subject.wardrobe: Oversized structured black blazer with minimal jewelry
subject.hair: Straight dark shoulder-length hair, center part

composition.background: Soft pale-grey studio gradient with subtle atmospheric blur
composition.subject_placement: Centered and dominant, visible from waist or hips upward
composition.floating_ui: Six to eight rounded rectangular music-player cards orbit around the subject at different depths; foreground cards are partially cropped and blurred
composition.depth: Cards at varied scales, some crisp and some defocused, with realistic perspective

interface_design.cards: Dark charcoal translucent panels mixed with frosted white panels, rounded corners and subtle shadows
interface_design.content: Small square album art, track title, artist name, progress line, timestamps and previous/pause/next controls
interface_design.accents: Small green music-service-style circular indicators without reproducing exact trademarks
interface_design.legibility: Use plausible short generic track names and clean interface typography

lighting.edge: Subtle warm highlights along blazer and hair
lighting.effects: Fine gold particle trails and tiny glints connecting some cards

camera.focus: Eyes and face sharp; near and far interface cards softly blurred

post_processing.style: High-end 3D compositing with photographic portrait realism
post_processing.finish: Cool neutral palette, restrained gold accents, clean digital campaign aesthetic

reverse_engineered_prompt.negative_prompt: No extra UI clutter, garbled interface text, duplicated controls, distorted face, extra fingers, visible trademarks, watermark.
